title: Ulasan produk
description: Analisis ulasan produk e-commerce: sentimen, aspek yang dibahas, apakah pembeli merekomendasikan, apakah ada keluhan, dan perkiraan rating bintang 1-5.

aspect.instructions: Which aspect of the purchase does this product review mainly talk about?

criteria.kualitas: product quality: material, durability, performance, whether it works or matches the description
criteria.harga: price: value for money, too expensive, cheap, discounts
criteria.pengiriman: delivery: shipping speed, courier, packaging, arrived damaged or late
criteria.pelayanan: service: seller response, customer service, returns, communication
criteria.lainnya: something else, or no specific aspect

would_recommend.instructions: Would the reviewer recommend this product to other buyers?

criteria.false: the reviewer would not recommend it, is unsure, or discourages buying
criteria.true: the reviewer recommends it or is clearly happy enough to buy again

complaint.instructions: Does the review contain a complaint about the product, delivery, price, or seller?

criteria.false: no complaint; only praise or neutral information
criteria.true: the reviewer complains about or criticizes something

rating.instructions: What star rating would the reviewer most likely give this product?
criteria: 1 star: very bad, the reviewer is angry or feels cheated
2 stars: bad, clearly disappointed with major problems
3 stars: average or mixed, some good and some bad points
4 stars: good, satisfied with only minor issues
5 stars: excellent, delighted and strongly recommends it
